summary: Describes two ways to produce the public and private key pairs that BGPsec routers use to sign their routing announcements: the router can generate its own keys, or the operator can generate them and install them. The public keys are published in the Resource Public Key Infrastructure so others can check the signatures.

eli5.summary: Each router needs its own secret stamp to sign its messages. This explains two ways to make the stamp: the router makes it itself, or its owner makes it and hands it over.

questions: how are bgpsec router keys generated
router driven vs operator driven keys
